preserved_results: Phase 2M-A's committed record and its checker are untouched. That record prices the object backend, which stays the package default for exactly this reason: a phase that changed the default before its own gate was graded would invalidate the baseline it is graded against. check_bank_storage_ledger.py must keep passing beside this record.

The five frozen mapping-axis banks are taken through the same _build_model and _selected_generators the R2b mapping record is built on, at the same selected_labels. This phase changes storage only; no instance, pool, budget or selection rule of the committed records is redefined.

estimand.name: 2M-B_retained_storage_reduction_of_the_packed_row_representation
estimand.question: At unchanged T_coeff and bitwise-unchanged matrix elements, how many bytes does the packed CSR/SoA representation retain against the dict-of-complex one, and on which banks does that reduction reach the 3x Phase 2M's go/no-go asks for?
estimand.why_it_exists: 2M-A measured the baseline and found 85.24--96.19 bytes per retained coefficient against a packed model of 24. That established headroom, not a reduction. This record measures the reduction an implementation actually delivers, and separates the part that is a property of the row representation from the part that depends on the bank.

packed_model_statement: Four bytes of ascending word index, four of the generation-order permutation, and sixteen of complex coefficient. That is the same 24 bytes MV.memory_estimate has always modelled and cached_operator_bytes has always reported; the permutation is not overhead added to the model, it is what lets the model be reached without moving an answer.

equivalence_gate.statement: Every priced bank is built under both backends and compared before any byte is reported: S and H bitwise equal via numpy array_equal, identical word universe, identical T_coeff, identical basis labels. A storage change that moved a matrix element would not be a storage change, and a byte reduction quoted from a bank whose answers drifted is worthless. The producer refuses to emit a row that fails this.
equivalence_gate.why_bitwise: MV.trace_pairing iterates the smaller operand's dict in insertion order, and 54--84% of resident rows are smaller than the reference, so the row drives the summation for most entries. Storing a row's words ascending -- the natural CSR choice -- moves 4--17% of S/H entries by up to 3.1e-13. MatrixElementBank._build_pair promises those entries reproduce solver.projected_matrices to the last bit, so tolerance is not the standard here; equality is.

frozen_mapping_axis.basis: Every declared mapping-axis instance at its frozen selected_labels -- the same banks Phase 2M-A priced, so the two records are directly comparable. They span 8 and 12 qubits but only 1.4--2.5 coefficient reuse, which is why they cannot carry the gate alone.

banks.extended_basis: Prefixes of the determinant-excitation pool at a declared basis size, taken in the builder's own enumeration order so the bank is a function of the config and nothing else. They exist to raise coefficient reuse: reuse is T_coeff/W, T_coeff grows with the pair count while W saturates, so a longer prefix over the same register reaches the regime the committed molecular banks occupy. The conserve_sz false rows are the full rank-2 pool and are storage instances, not physics: they carry S_z-violating excitations, no energy of theirs is reported, and they revise no scientific record.
banks.reuse_span_statement: The priced set must span at least a factor of twenty in coefficient reuse. The whole finding of this record is that the reduction is a function of reuse rather than a constant, and a bank set clustered at one reuse could not show that, let alone locate the threshold where the gate clears.

layout_statement: Both are measured because Phase 2M-B asks for interleaved complex data to be benchmarked against structure-of-arrays real/imaginary storage. They hold identical bytes -- sixteen per coefficient either way -- so the comparison is of access cost, and the record reports the byte equality as a checked fact rather than an assumption.

go_no_go.graded_clause_statement: Phase 2M's go/no-go has three clauses. This record grades the first -- at least a 3x reduction in retained coefficient storage at unchanged T_coeff -- because the packed representation now exists and can be measured. It grades neither of the others.

ungraded_clauses.streaming_policy_bounds_live_rows: Phase 2M-C. No eviction policy exists; this record is entirely retain_all.
ungraded_clauses.stretched_h2o_m31_below_15_gib: Phase 2M-D. An end-to-end feasibility run, not a storage measurement, and nothing here may stand in for it.

go_no_go.denominator_statement: The reduction is measured on total retained bytes -- packed rows plus the shared word table they index into -- and not on rows alone. Rows alone is the representation's own ratio and is reported beside it, but the table is real resident memory that the object backend does not pay separately, so grading on rows alone would be the flattering reading of a gate that exists to be failed.

claim_boundary: Structural storage-accounting evidence only, on declared banks in one interpreter. Nothing is sampled, no energy is reported as a result, and no resource price of any kind is produced. Byte counts of live Python objects are a property of the CPython build that measured them, so the record declares its interpreter and the checker compares them under a declared tolerance while every count, pair and packed byte stays exact. The reduction reported for a bank is that bank's; the record establishes that the reduction rises with coefficient reuse and locates where it crosses 3x on the measured ladder, and it may not be read as a reduction for a bank outside the measured reuse range without saying so. The committed molecular banks are not rebuilt here -- their reuse is read from Phase 2M-A's record and compared against the measured threshold, which is a comparison of one number against another and not a measurement of those runs. This record grades one clause of Phase 2M's go/no-go and explicitly not the other two: no streaming policy exists to bound live rows, and no end-to-end run under a memory ceiling has been performed, so no statement here licenses a claim that Phase 2M passes.
